## What

Brief description of the change.

## Why

What problem does this solve or what does it improve?

## Type

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Skill improvement
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Docs / validation / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `./validate-skills.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Skill name matches directory name
- [ ] Description includes trigger phrases (for new/updated skills)
- [ ] Related skills are cross-referenced in both description and body
- [ ] Added entry to `marketplace.json` (new skills only)
- [ ] Added entry to `VERSIONS.md` (new skills only)
